items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: All right. Abner Jones was his name

ctx.x: If you learned clarinet first, you'd be better off to pick up a saxophone after alto, but I didn't learn it first.

Now, I'm gonna give you something else. Here in Houston, when I come up in the thirties, we didn't have no instructors. I'm a self made musician. We had one guy that knew theory and could teach it --but he was so busy, he didn't have the time. The whites wouldn't accept you as a black. Are you listening good?
Yeah. I know what you're saying.
